best_idea: When the server corrects a position, classify the error by size (ignore a tiny one, glide to the server point for a small one, snap for a large one) and keep the server as the only validator.
decision_why: Kills and hits are server-verified, so the band must never decide a hit or kill; it fits the world client's remote creatures and NPCs as a display rule only.
acceptance: A remote creature 0.15 to 3.74 m from its server point slides to it over frames, and one farther away appears at the server point with no slide; a server test asserts stored positions and kill results never read the client actor transform.
